name: Bharat Petroleum
about: Bharat Petroleum Corporation Limited (BPCL) is one of India's largest and most successful public sector undertakings, recognized as a Maharatna company. BPCL has evolved from its origins as Burmah-Shell into a global Fortune 500 oil refining, exploration, and marketing conglomerate. The company operates through two main segments: Downstream Petroleum, which includes refining and marketing of petroleum products, and Exploration and Production (E&P), focusing on hydrocarbons. With a rich history that began with international collaborations in the early 20th century, BPCL today plays a crucial role in India's energy sector, driving growth and innovation.
